City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 21, 2014 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 4/23/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-05-21 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-05-21 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Introduction of Ordinance No. 2014-05 amending Municipal Code Section 2.20 regarding duties and salary for the elected Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council Members. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2014-05 entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Section 2.20 Regarding Duties and Salary for Elected Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council Members."
2014-05-21 Item 8C - Ordinance 2014-05 Duties and Salary for Elected Mayor and Council
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Council to meet with applicants for and make appointments to the Youth Commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving on the commission and, by ballot, make appointments to the Youth Commission.
2014-05-21 Item 10A - Youth Commission Interviews 2014
10B.
Continued Public Hearing related to the adjustment of traffic mitigation fees, and introduction of Ordinance 2014-04, amending Municipal Code Chapter 23.94, regarding traffic mitigation fees. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Deane
1) Conduct a Public Hearing related to the Traffic Mitigation Fees and Introduction of Ordinance 2014-04; 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-24 approving the Traffic Mitigation Fees; and 3) Introduce Ordinance 2014-04, entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 23.94 regarding Traffic Mitigation Fees" and return on June 11, 2014 for adoption of Ordinance 2014-04.
2014-05-21 Item 10B - Continued Public Hearing - Traffic Mitigation Fees
10C.
City Manager's Proposed FY14/15 Operating Budget and FY14/15 and FY15/16 Capital Improvement Budget and the six-year Financial Plan. Contact Person: City Manager Vina
This report is the second of three related to the Proposed FY14/15 Operating and Capital budgets and six year Financial Plan presented to the City Council for their discussion and direction to staff. In this budget report, staff recommends that the City Council provide: 1) an intent motion to approve the FY14/15 and FY15/16 Capital Improvement Budget, including any debt financing necessary for capital projects, 2) an intent motion for the funding of Strategic Plan initiatives, 3) direction to staff on city-owned assets, and 4) direction to staff on the concept of a pilot parking project with North County Transit District (NCTD).
2014-05-21 Item 10C - Budget Report with Attachments
2014-05-21 Item 10C - Budget Power Point

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
